sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/cli_argparse.py
# ============================================================
# ARGPARSE — Command-Line Interface
# ============================================================
import argparse

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Process data files",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog="""
Examples:
  python app.py input.csv --output result.json
  python app.py data.txt --verbose --format json
        """
    )
    
    # Positional argument
    parser.add_argument("input_file", help="Path to input file")
    
    # Optional arguments
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default="output.txt", help="Output file path")
    parser.add_argument("-f", "--format", choices=["json", "csv", "xml"], default="json")
    parser.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", help="Enable verbose mode")
    parser.add_argument("-n", "--count", type=int, default=10, help="Number of items")
    parser.add_argument("--tags", nargs="+", help="List of tags")  # Multiple values
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="version", version="1.0.0")
    
    # Subcommands
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")
    
    create_parser = subparsers.add_parser("create", help="Create new item")
    create_parser.add_argument("name", help="Item name")
    
    delete_parser = subparsers.add_parser("delete", help="Delete item")
    delete_parser.add_argument("id", type=int, help="Item ID")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(args)
```
